tools.name: get_postmark_pricing
tools.description: Get Postmark's published pricing. Given a monthly email volume, returns the monthly price of each plan at the tier that covers it, plus every tier for comparison. Prices only — this does not read or change any account.

monthlyEmailVolume.description: Emails expected per month. Omit to get the full price table.

tools.name: list_postmark_agent_skills
tools.description: List the Postmark Agent Skills published at this origin — installable instructions for sending email, processing inbound email, managing templates, handling webhooks and email best practices. Returns each skill's name, description and URL.

tools.name: search_postmark_docs
tools.description: Search Postmark's documentation, developer reference, guides and help articles. Returns matching page titles, URLs, categories and excerpts. Use this to find how a Postmark feature works or which API endpoint to call, rather than guessing a documentation URL.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. "webhook retries", "DKIM setup", "message streams".
